notes: P1 (END A): POWER WIRES SOLDERED DIRECTLY TO THE XT30 POWER PINS, INLINE (STRAIGHT, 0 DEG).
P2 (END B): POWER WIRES SOLDERED DIRECTLY TO THE XT30 POWER PINS, INLINE (STRAIGHT, 0 DEG).

J1 (END A SIGNAL): JST GHR-02V-S HOUSING, SIGNAL WIRES CRIMPED TO JST SSHL-002T-P0.2 CONTACTS: SIG1 (GREEN) TO PIN 1, SIG2 (YELLOW) TO PIN 2. PIN 1 IS ON THE LEFT VIEWED FROM THE WIRE SIDE WITH THE LATCH UP. THE SIGNAL PAIR RUNS SEPARATELY FROM THE POWER WIRES, 400 MM TO THE REAR OF J1.

J2 (END B SIGNAL): JST GHR-02V-S HOUSING, SIGNAL WIRES CRIMPED TO JST SSHL-002T-P0.2 CONTACTS: SIG1 (GREEN) TO PIN 1, SIG2 (YELLOW) TO PIN 2. PIN 1 IS ON THE LEFT VIEWED FROM THE WIRE SIDE WITH THE LATCH UP. THE SIGNAL PAIR RUNS SEPARATELY FROM THE POWER WIRES, 400 MM TO THE REAR OF J2.
10 MM LENGTH OF Ø4.0 MM BLACK 2:1 HEAT SHRINK OVER EACH POWER SOLDER JOINT AT P1 AND P2 (4 PIECES, ONE PER POWER WIRE PER END; NOT OVER THE SIGNAL WIRES). SLIDE ON BEFORE SOLDERING.
TWIST SIGNAL PAIR: T=33 TWISTS OVER RUN (APPROX 12 MM LAY).
POWER WIRE: UL3135 SILICONE RUBBER INSULATED, 600V, 200C, 16 AWG 252/0.08 MM TINNED COPPER. SIGNAL WIRE: 30 AWG STRANDED TINNED COPPER, CRIMPED TO JST SSHL-002T-P0.2 CONTACTS.
WIRE COLORS: PIN+ RED, PIN- BLACK, SIG1 GREEN, SIG2 YELLOW.
WIRE LENGTH 400+/-15 MM, MEASURED ALONG THE WIRE BETWEEN THE REAR FACES OF THE END A AND END B CONNECTORS (CONNECTOR BODIES NOT INCLUDED). WIRE CUT LENGTHS: POWER 410 MM, SIGNAL 440 MM.
100% CONTINUITY TEST: NO OPENS, SHORTS, OR MISWIRES. CONDUCTION RESISTANCE <= 3 OHM; INSULATION RESISTANCE >= 10 MOHM.
